rationale: The signal establishes continuity of packet identity during post-assembly handling. It provides no evidence of the original internal arrangement, so it cannot prove that D-17 preserves its unchanged original authorial arrangement.

signal_basis.exact_text: No entry describes internal leaf position, revision, attachment or binding, and all entries postdate assembly.
Independent signatures and intact seals corroborate each transfer; the packet is the same packet throughout the three-day archive-loan interval.
The histories differ only in pre-accession internal order, not later handling.
